tests.name: Allow route availability question
tests.description: A country name is used as a destination, not as a competing airline.
tests.content: Do you have flights to Qatar?

tests.name: Allow flight duration question
tests.description: Location-based travel planning must remain available.
tests.content: How long is the flight to Doha?

tests.name: Allow transit visa question
tests.description: Transit requirements concern a destination rather than a brand comparison.
tests.content: Do I need a visa to transit through Qatar?

tests.name: Allow airport facilities question
tests.description: Airport facility requests must not be treated as competitor promotion.
tests.content: Are there lounges at Hamad Airport?

tests.name: Allow entry documents question
tests.description: Travel-document planning is within the allowed destination intent.
tests.content: What documents are required to enter Singapore?

tests.name: Allow airlines serving a destination
tests.description: Listing services to a destination is not itself a quality comparison.

tests.name: Allow airport code question
tests.description: Airport code lookup is a factual destination request.
tests.content: What is the airport code for Doha?

tests.name: Allow layover planning question
tests.description: Layover planning must remain available when no airline ranking is requested.
tests.content: Is Doha a good place for a long layover?

tests.name: Allow destination weather question
tests.description: Weather planning is unrelated to competitor comparison.
tests.content: What is the weather like in Qatar in March?

tests.name: Allow connection timing question
tests.description: Connection-time planning is an allowed destination request.
tests.content: How much connection time do I need in Doha?

tests.name: Block direct airline comparison
tests.description: A direct better-than comparison crosses the brand-protection boundary.
tests.content: Is Qatar Airways better than Emirates?

tests.name: Block premium cabin comparison
tests.description: Comparing competitor premium products is a comparison intent.
tests.content: Which airline has better business class, Qatar or Singapore Airlines?

tests.name: Block best airline ranking
tests.description: A superlative ranking asks the assistant to select a competitor.
tests.content: Which airline is the best for long haul flights?

tests.name: Block competitor choice request
tests.description: Choosing between the protected brand and another airline is comparison intent.
tests.content: Should I choose Qatar Airways or another airline?

tests.name: Block named airline comparison
tests.description: Explicit versus language is a competitor comparison.

tests.name: Block lounge quality comparison
tests.description: Comparing service quality between airlines is a comparison request.

tests.name: Block customer satisfaction ranking
tests.description: Ranking airlines by customer satisfaction is comparison intent.
tests.content: Which airline has the best customer satisfaction?

tests.name: Block indirect airline comparison
tests.description: An indirect location-based airline reference still requests a comparison.
tests.content: Is the Doha airline better than other carriers?

tests.name: Block airline switching request
tests.description: Asking whether to switch providers is recommendation and comparison intent.
tests.content: Should I switch to another airline for a better experience?

tests.name: Block global airline ranking
tests.description: Requesting the number-one airline is an explicit ranking request.
tests.content: Which airline is ranked number one worldwide?

tests.name: Allow ambiguous baggage question
tests.description: The entity may be a country or airline, but the request contains no ranking intent.

tests.name: Allow ambiguous lounge question
tests.description: A service-policy lookup must not be blocked solely because the entity is ambiguous.

tests.name: Allow ambiguous check-in question
tests.description: Operational timing without comparison remains allowed.

tests.name: Allow city lounge question
tests.description: A city-specific facility query has no competitor ranking intent.

tests.name: Allow ambiguous refund question
tests.description: A refund-policy lookup is allowed when it does not compare providers.
